subject: Request: Exec waiver for CloudPoint Hosted API 22% discount + Net-45 terms
messages:
From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Exec waiver for CloudPoint Hosted API 22% discount + Net-45 terms

Team —

Quick background: CloudPoint (SaaS infra) is on a short vendor list for a multiregion pilot. They want to convert a 12-month committed Hosted API plan starting June 1 with an expected first-year run-rate of ~$780k ARR. Pricing ask: 22% off list for token usage + Net-45 invoicing (they asked Net-60 but will accept Net-45). They also requested a clause for a limited production data residency pilot in our EU region (legal to vet).

Why this matters: strategic sale into a major cloud customer with strong reference potential plus a marketplace co-sell motion local to EMEA. Marketing uplift + potential for Dedicated conversation next year. Our play: 12-month commit at 22% with a 60-day pilot credit holdback and standard SLOs; they need the faster payment terms (Net-45) to satisfy procurement.

Ask: Seeking senior approval for the >20% discount and exception to our standard Net-30 terms. Legal review needed for the data residency addendum and the proposed holdback language. Attached: CloudPoint_Pricing_Proposal.xlsx (breakdown) and CloudPoint_Draft_SOW.pdf (draft SOW).

Key numbers:
- List token rate: $0.0008/token
- Proposed rate after 22% discount: $0.000624/token
- Commit: 12 months; estimated 1.2B tokens yr1
- Expected ARR (yr1): ~$780k

If approved, I plan to send the attached redline-ready SOW and DocuSign link to the customer today.

Thanks,
David
David Kim
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Exec waiver for CloudPoint Hosted API 22% discount + Net-45 terms

+1 to approving conditioned on the contract guardrails below. A few quick points from deal desk:
- This is strategically high-value (marketplace + EMEA expansion) — we should prioritize cadence.
- The 22% discount is slightly above our standard senior floor but within precedent for a 12-month commit + marketplace co-sell.
- Require: non-renewal auto-approval for rate reversion to list after anniversary unless renewed at prior terms.
- Require finance signoff for Net-45 (we've done Net-45 for a handful of strategic deals).
- Suggested credit / holdback: keep 15% of the first invoice as a conditional credit released after 60 days if SLOs met.

I updated the HubSpot deal notes (link) with ARR and recommended approval rationale: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345/CP-2027-042

Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Mid-Market Sales

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Exec waiver for CloudPoint Hosted API 22% discount + Net-45 terms

Thanks for the succinct summary, David. I reviewed the economics and the strategic upside; I will approve a 22% one-year discount for CloudPoint on the following conditions:

1) Commit must be 12 months and non-cancellable. Price will revert to list at renewal unless we negotiate an extension.
2) Net-45 payment terms are approved for this deal only; finance to confirm the AR treatment and credit limits.
3) Include a 15% first-invoice holdback that is released after 60 days if SLOs are met and no critical production incidents.
4) Legal (Stephanie) to sign off on the data residency addendum and the SOW redlines prior to DocuSign.
5) Marketing will be granted a reference call after 90 days contingent on performance (Marissa to coordinate).

Marissa / Stephanie: please confirm you can action items 4 and 5 today so we can close by EOD.

Approval granted on the conditions above. Please make sure the final DocuSign package contains the holdback widget and explicit renewal language.

Mina Haddad
VP Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: Anya Patel <anya@cloudpoint.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 11:50:00 -0700
Subject: CloudPoint — Exec approval and next steps (22% discount)

Anya — great to chat this morning. Quick note to confirm next steps and an approved commercial position.

Executive decision: Redwood has approved a 22% discount on Hosted API token pricing for your 12-month committed plan. This approval is conditional on the items below (internal counsel and finance have been looped):

- Commit: 12 months starting June 1, non-cancellable.
- Rate: 22% off list as discussed ($0.000624/token).
- Payment: Net-45 (finance approval pending final credit check).
- Holdback: 15% of the first invoice will be held and released 60 days after go-live if SLOs are met (language will be in the SOW).
- Data residency: we can support a limited EU-region residency pilot; legal to finalize addendum.
- Reference: Marketing may request a reference call after 90 days (optional).

Attached are the pricing worksheet and a redline-ready SOW. Stephanie from legal will send any redlines this afternoon; once legal confirms, I will send the DocuSign package. Expect a DocuSign link by EOD if legal signs off.

If anything above is a blocker on your side, please flag it now. Otherwise, we will proceed to finalize.

Best,
David
David Kim
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
